Version 1
SubGoalCombiner SGC_AND

INITSECTION
  DB_Example_Ready(1);

KBSECTION
  IF
    ExampleEvent((CHARACTER)_Actor, _Value)
  AND
    NOT DB_Example_Disabled(_Actor)
  AND
    _Value >= 1
  THEN
    DB_Example_Seen(_Actor);
    NOT DB_Example_Pending(_Actor);

  PROC
    PROC_Example_Clear((CHARACTER)_Actor)
  THEN
    NOT DB_Example_Seen(_Actor);

  QRY
    QRY_Example_IsReady()
  AND
    DB_Example_Ready(1)
  THEN
    DB_NOOP(1);

EXITSECTION
  NOT DB_Example_Ready(1);
  GoalCompleted;
ENDEXITSECTION

ParentTargetEdge "Example_Parent"
